overview:
Get ready, Australia! The nation's biggest obsession just got a whole lot juicier. The Married At First Sight universe is expanding like never before with the launch of MAFS: After The Dinner Party, your first and only place to dive into exclusive, unfiltered interviews with the participants right after the show's iconic dinner parties. Plus, fans will have the chance to see unseen footage that picks up right where the main show leaves off, offering even more drama and insight.

With Jules Lund, Brittany Hockley, and Laura Byrne steering the conversation, the debrief starts the second the dinner party ends. MAFS: After The Dinner Party is the ultimate companion series, offering an unapologetic look at the season's biggest scandals. Whether it’s the 'red flags' or catching a first glimpse of the wreckage, this is the essential, no-holds-barred breakdown where the tea is spilt, and the real truth is revealed.
name: MAFS: After The Dinner Party

overview: Two life-long friends, Jeff and Brendan, lead a daring expedition deep into the Australian Outback, to find a legendary fortune in gold and solve a 100-year-old mystery.
name: Hunting Outback Gold

overview: Denmark's most unapologetic reality icons have found each other. Across six unfiltered episodes, Janni Ree and Linse Kessler open their lives wide open - navigating midlife with brutal honesty, fearless humor, and a bond that proves two divas are far greater than the sum of their parts.
name: Divaer – Stærkere Sammen

overview: A live comedy and improvisation show, every episode of This Is Not A Dating Show brings together 100 singles who have been seriously unlucky in love. A difficult task, but nothing Galder Varas can't handle. And if nobody hooks up, at least we'll have had a laugh.
name: This Is Not A Dating Show

overview: Orange County Choppers Original brings the legendary shop back to its roots -- real bikes, real stories, and the raw, unfiltered energy that made OCC a household name.
name: Orange County Choppers Original

overview: In De Drop, Thomas, Giel, and Stefan are dropped off separately in the middle of the night at an often eerie, deserted location. The goal? Survive the night or complete a task to win money for the pot. And that might sound easier than it is.
name: The Drop

original_name: รันนิ่งแมนไทยแลนด์ อย่า หยุด วิ่ง
overview: At the heart of the show are the 7 Main Agents, a powerhouse lineup of A-list stars who command massive, dedicated fanbases across the globe. They are ready to deliver multi-dimensional entertainment through intense competitions and challenging missions in every episode. Adding to the excitement, the show will feature an impressive roster of special guest stars, including Thailand’s top-tier artists and surprise guests flying in directly from South Korea, creating a truly dynamic entertainment phenomenon.
name: Running Man Thailand

original_name: History's Greatest Picks with Mike Wolfe
overview: With an eye for the unique and a passion for historic collectibles, Mike guides viewers through surprising new details about bizarre artifacts and rare collectibles. Bringing history to life one pick at time, the series reveals the secrets and significance of elusive finds, while telling the incredible backstories.
name: History's Greatest Picks with Mike Wolfe

overview: Actress Kim Tae-ri, a first-time teacher, starts a theatre club at a rural school on the verge of closure. Together with the students, she builds a unique after-school theatre club, capturing real, unscripted lessons and growth. As the stage comes to life, small changes begin to ripple beyond the classroom.
name: Curtain Up, Class!

original_name: Police Interceptors: Taking Down the Shoplifting Gangs
overview: Officers tackle the thieves terrorising supermarkets and shops, with organised international crime groups stealing eye-watering amounts in increasingly industrial, brazen and sophisticated ways.
name: Police Interceptors: Taking Down the Shoplifting Gangs

overview: Aryan, an ambitious creative professional, is determined to build a successful future, but emotional wounds from his past keep him guarded. His life changes when he meets Arhan, a calm and sincere young man who believes strongly in destiny and human connection.
name: You Are My Only Star

overview: Work hard, play harder? Olivia Attwood throws 10 ambitious young chefs into Jean-Christophe Novelli’s Barcelona kitchen, where things continue to heat up long after service stops.
name: The Heat

overview: Danny Dyer and daughter Dani try their hand at investing in and running a holiday caravan park in the UK. With childhood nostalgia in his heart and business ambition in his sights, Danny and Dani are diving headfirst into the £7 billion holiday park industry. They’ll stop at nothing in their quest to transform a caravan park into a place that lives up to Danny’s misty-eyed memories of the best holidays he’s ever had in his life.
name: The Dyers' Caravan Park

overview: Two Norwegian TV personalities ditch their everyday lives to buy and fix up a place in a tiny Italian town. They barely speak the language, can't really renovate, and their budget is laughably small. Everything goes sideways constantly, but they insist it's all a love story.
name: Solveig og Johns dolce villa

original_name: Sur la route avec Matt Pokora
name: Sur la route avec Matt Pokora

overview: The final six singers of "Singer Again" Season 4 will compete to reach the top. Their mission: Work with producers to create a hit song that will dominate the charts.
name: Yumyeonggasuegen Hiteugogi Pillyohae

overview: Victor, Chris and Rob are back, trying to solve various tasks in their own chaotic way.
name: Kaoskassa

overview: Don't hold back and eat! A building restaurant that regains the happiness of life and creates a healthy daily life in the pleasure of taste.
name: Healthy Restaurant

overview: Jonathan Ross hosts this reality challenge in which nine pairs of strangers with different beliefs, lifestyles, opinions and habits are handcuffed together for as long as they can stand it. The pairs must navigate eating, dressing and even sleeping just inches apart as they are sent on a road trip across the UK - with the ones who last the longest in the running for £100,000. From a bar tender and a millionaire to an alpha male and a proud feminist, which couple will be the first to take the cuffs off?
name: Handcuffed: Last Pair Standing

overview: Comedians and best friends D'Arcy Carden and Sherry Cola hit the road to discover the wildest vacation rentals across America.
name: Wild Vacation Rentals

overview: Welcome to "The Box": a brand-new reality game show where instinct, adaptability, and quick thinking make the difference between winning and being eliminated. Ten unknown Flemish people compete, each individually locked in a mysterious yellow box. Each time a box opens, the participants find themselves in a new challenge with unfamiliar rules. The contestants must discover the purpose for themselves, often in absurd situations. Who will keep a cool head and react the fastest? The last contestant standing after eight episodes will be crowned the winner of "The Box" and take home €15,000.
name: De Box

overview: Exposing the darker side of America's most beloved TV shows with untold stories from past participants and new original reporting.
name: Dirty Rotten Scandals

overview: Seven couples move out of their comfort zones and onto the therapist's couch to try and work through their relationship issues in this reality series.
name: Blue Therapy

overview: Long referred to but never before seen, the mythical and delicious Flavortown will be the setting for this multi-round, culinary competition. In each episode, Fieri will welcome three chefs to Flavortown where skills and cooking chops can earn advantages and ultimately a win. Competitors will choose their own adventure as they compete in authentic food establishments ranging from street food carts to neighborhood spots to fast casual eateries and the finest fine dining restaurants in the world. The chefs must be quick on their feet as their culinary knowledge, technical skills, and overall cooking acumen are tested round after round. With restaurant names inspired by Guy's life, the series will deliver everything fans have ever dreamed Flavortown could be. The winner of each episode has a chance to score up to $20,000 in prize money and will return to defend their title against two new chefs the following week.
name: Flavortown Food Fight

overview: Top chefs compete in challenges testing creativity, endurance, presentation and leadership skills in America's Culinary Cup.
name: America's Culinary Cup

overview: Ten public figures must survive alone in the wilderness without their phones, then unite and work together to make it back to civilization.
name: Hors réseau : l'expérience

overview: For Road Trippers VIPS, three teams of Dutch celebrities are dropped off in a remote Thai village. They receive a small allowance, just €50, and must travel as far as possible from the starting point within fourteen days. Along the way, they must be resourceful enough to earn money, for example, by washing dishes or working the land. They also have to arrange their own transportation, for example, by scooter, tuk-tuk, or hitchhiking. Luxury hotels are also out of the question, so this journey requires a lot of perseverance. After two weeks, we'll see which team has traveled the furthest from the starting point. That team wins.
name: Roadtrippers VIPS

original_name: Must Be the Music. Tylko muzyka
name: Must Be the Music. Tylko muzyka

overview: “A comedy‑driven watch‑along special featuring Anthony Montgomery, Rashaan Nall, and Red Grant as they react to the first four Leprechaun films. Blending humor, commentary, and franchise nostalgia, the special delivers a fun, personality‑packed dive into the cult‑classic horror series.”
name: Leprechaun Watch Party Special

overview: Age is thrown out the window when singles search for their soulmates. Is love truly ageless, or will the years come between them?
name: Age of Attraction

overview:
Each episode features five Dutch celebrities who sit down for a special dinner and share their most embarrassing experiences and spicy anecdotes. This is part of the concept for the new reality show "Het Diner" (The Dinner), hosted by Raymond Thiry.

There's a catch, though. Some celebrities at the table have a good reason to hijack someone else's story or lie about their own. This creates a game full of manipulation and tasteful storytelling.

Each dinner starts with a pot of €25,000: the goal is to keep as much of that money as possible at the end of the evening. This only works if they discover who is worth €0 and vote that person out. If they vote the wrong person out, the amount that person was worth disappears from the pot.
name: Het Diner

overview: The unplanned and unpredictable wanderings of Lee Seo-jin and Na Young-seok through Texas.
name: 이서진의 달라달라

overview: In the highly commercialized idol industry, emotions are often manufactured and sold as part of the brand. Scandal Love follows four women navigating different levels of power within a K-pop girl group system. As they struggle with strict contracts, overwhelming public scrutiny, and their own genuine feelings, each is forced to make impossible choices. The series explores one central question: can real love survive inside relationships that are carefully designed and controlled?
name: Scandal love

overview: Devin Zellars takes viewers deep into the night along the legendary Ohio River for an unforgettable catfishing adventure. Armed with skill, passion, and a love for the outdoors, Devin tracks down his first major catch under the stars. The show kicks off the series with grit, excitement, and real storytelling setting the tone for an epic global journey through waters known and unknown.
name: Fish Kings Show

overview:
The new series is called "Real Travelers' Wives" and shows trailer park life through the eyes of women. They are often the lifeblood of the household, family, and extended family.

The women are expected to adhere to the norms, values, and traditions of the trailer park, but some are cautiously trying to move in a more modern direction. This isn't always appreciated and causes friction.
name: Echte Reizigersvrouwen

original_name: The Real Housewives of Rhode Island
overview: Set against the shores of the Ocean State, “The Real Housewives” franchise expands into the world of a tight-knit circle of Rhode Islanders who have deep community roots and families that go back generations. With aspirational lives, thriving businesses and tangled family dynamics, these decade-long friendships prove that in a state this small, there’s no escaping your past… or each other.
name: The Real Housewives of Rhode Island

overview: Eva Longoria explores French cuisine and culture.
name: Eva Longoria: Searching for France

overview: Kevin Hart travels the country with the help of comedy legends to find the next stand-up superstar — with the winner crowned live by your real-time vote.
name: Funny AF with Kevin Hart
